lines.text: Jeremiah laments being a man of strife, and the LORD promises to deliver him for a good purpose.
The LORD will give up Jeremiah's wealth as plunder and enslave him to his enemies in a land he does not know.
Jeremiah ate the LORD's words, which became his joy, and he sat alone away from the band of revelers.
Jeremiah asks the LORD to avenge him against his persecutors and says the LORD has become like a lion to him.
If Jeremiah speaks noble words, he will be the LORD's spokesman, and the LORD will make him a fortified wall of clay.
